notes.title: The 2nd Open Beta has started!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=iy8gSYVJaIU;full][/previewyoutube]
Dear Patchers,

The 2nd Open Beta of “The Patcher” has begun!

Press the "Demo" button on the store page to install or update.

For this Open Beta, we offer you the new content as below.

[olist]
[*][b]Boss Raid Mode[/b]
[list]
[*]A large-scale combat mode in PvPvE: both camps have to clash against each other while the giant boss Tantalus is in the center attacks both camps.
Various rewards provided from each mission in the Boss-Raid

[/list]


[*][b]New weapons
[/b]Diversification in functions and stat such as attack types and range
Able to obtain through account level-up, Battlefield bosses rewards, Boss-Raid rewards, or store purchases

[*][b]New skills: ‘Execution’ & ‘Dash’[/b]
Execution: eliminate the opponent with a sword. 
Dash: widens and narrows the distance from the opponent instantly.
Able to obtain these skills from the cartridges.

[*][b]Main UI improvement[/b]
Major UI/UX reorganization
Introduction of equippable weapon inventory

[*]Tutorial
In-game voice improvement

[*]Fixed minor bugs 
[/olist]
If you have any inconveniences or suggestions during the gameplay, please email feedback@pixelitygames.com. 

Your support will help us significantly enhance the "The Patcher's" completeness through this 2nd open beta. Also, if you kindly leave an email on the [url=http://thepatchervr.com/]pre-registration page[/url] or join our [url=https://discord.com/channels/884343898149879869/918056617268871178]Discord channel[/url], we will deliver the latest news.

Thank You,

[b]Pixelity Games "The Patcher" Operation Team[/b]


[i]*Please be cautious that the game records of the beta test will be initialized after the test period.[/i]

notes.title: The Patcher's 1st Open Beta started!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40473470/690f24af67e5b4a172dcfac4701ba9f2fff0ffd8.png[/img]

Dear Patchers,

The first beta test of [b]“The Patcher”[/b] has started!

You can install or update through '[b]DEMO[/b]' button!

This time, we introduce some new features and improve the existing contents.

[list]
[*]New Hunting Ground: Battlefield
[*]New Game System: Shop and Skills
[*]Tutorial and Deathmatch improved
[*]Optimization and minor bugs fixed
[*]Valve Index and HP Reverb G2 support
[/list]

In addition, as you play the game, if there is anything to share and suggest, please feel free to post on the Steam community or send us an Email to feedback@pixelitygames.com. We will review your words to improve our game. Your valuable opinions will be appreciated.

Through this beta, we would like to ask for your support for [b]“The Patcher”[/b] to make the game perfect.

Also, if you leave your Email address on [url=http://thepatchervr.com/]the pre-registration page[/url], we will share the latest news about "The Patcher" right away!

Thank you.

[b]Pixelity Games "The Patcher" Operation Team[/b]


[i]*Please be cautious that the game records of the beta test will be initialised after the test period.[/i]
